parts.text:
Antidiuretic hormone (ADH) is involved in the maintenance of a constant blood water potential.

A student drank $0.5\text{dm}^3$ of water and the concentration of ADH in their blood was measured every 30 minutes for 3 hours.

Fig. 9.1 shows the results of this investigation.

{{figure:figure_9_1.png}}

Explain the results shown in Fig. 9.1.
